captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a utility blimp or airship with a large, light-grey, cigar-shaped envelope segmented by subtle panel lines. Below the envelope, a dark-grey structural gondola is suspended along the centerline, flanked by twin engine nacelles supported by thin struts. The rear features a cruciform tail assembly with light-grey horizontal stabilizers and vertical fins, each possessing active control surfaces. The propellers on the twin nacelles are designed to rotate continuously, while the rudder and elevator panels articulate on their respective vertical and horizontal hinges.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a utility blimp with a segmented cigar-shaped envelope in light grey, a centerline gondola underneath, and twin engine nacelles on the sides. Incorporate a cruciform tail assembly at the rear, featuring a vertical fin with an articulating rudder and horizontal stabilizers with articulating elevators. Ensure the propellers on the side engines are set up for continuous rotation.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blimp envelope by lofting or revolving circular cross-sections to create the cigar shape, adding segmented visual rings. The gondola is built from a rounded box or cylinder primitive and positioned beneath the envelope. Side nacelles are modeled using cylinders with conical ends, supported by thin cylindrical struts. The cruciform tail fins are extruded profiles, with separate movable control surfaces (rudder and elevators) attached via revolute joints. Propellers are modeled as small hubs with helical or angled blades, attached to the nacelles via continuous joints for rotation.
